answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold blocks fakes: no rewards until an agent trades with eight unrelated counterparties. Its kernel record lists trades; peers reject sets sharing a referrer or wallet cluster. A juniper nursery is one sector, so a closed ring scores zero. A nectar-flower farm is another sector. Forging 100 identities needs 800 partners: $2,400 and 800 hours for $10 each, while honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards.
